messages:
Leah: quick ping  noticed a small spike in 'renewal-touch' sends this morning, looks correlated with healthscore reweighting.
Marcus: saw dashboard blip; +320 sends between 05:10-05:30 UTC. link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/outbound-touch-rate?filter=renewal-touch
Dina: any deploys to scoring last night?
Oliver: yes, scoring team pushed v2.3 of healthscore transform at 04:55 that changed tenure_weight from 0.12 -> 0.4. commit: feat(score): boost tenure influence.
eng-bot: ALERT: HEALTHSCORE_REWEIGHT_ANOMALY #3955554321 severity=medium; affected_cohort=midmarket; delta_count=320
Leah: impact: 320 extra nudges across 48 accounts; 7 accounts have renewals in <30d. we should avoid noisy outreach.
Marcus: plan: 1) pause outbound rule 'renewal-touch' for source=healthscore-auto 2) roll back tenure_weight to 0.12 3) identify duplicates and suppress extras 4) notify the 7 AMs 5) add preflight simulation for scoring changes. agree?
Dina: agree. I'll pause automation: `playbook.pause(rule=renewal-touch, source=healthscore-auto)`
eng-bot: command acknowledged: playbook.pause succeeded (scope: healthscore-auto).
Oliver: reverting transform now; opening rollback PR and adding a guard to prevent tenure_weight > 0.2 in prod.
Marcus: running query to list affected accounts: `select account_id, count(*) as sends from outbound where rule='renewal-touch' and created_at between '2025-09-09T05:10' and '2025-09-09T05:30' group by account_id having sends>1` -> /tmp/dup_395555.csv
Leah: suppression dry-run looks safe: 312 duplicates flagged, canonical 48 left. schedule prod suppression in 15m.
Dina: owners for 7 renewals need direct DM; I'll craft template and send after suppression completes.
eng-bot: rollback deploy started (canary).
Oliver: canary passed, guard test added. promoting to prod now.
eng-bot: rollback completed in prod; tenure_weight set to 0.12.
Marcus: executed suppression: suppressed=312 duplicates, failures=0. queued 7 accounts for manual AM reachout.
Leah: AM DM template: "Heads-up: transient scoring change caused extra renewal nudges for <account>. We've suppressed duplicates and reverted scoring config. Please expect one fewer automated touch. Reply if you want us to hold all outreach."
Dina: sent DMs; two AMs requested a brief note to their execs, sending now.
Marcus: follow-ups: add scoring preflight job that runs on a production snapshot and compares tag deltas, add deploy-time validator for weight bounds, and add an alert for outbound_delta > 0.5% hourly. I'll own alert and runbook additions.
Oliver: I'll add preflight and validator. also adding a CI test that fails if transform change alters >5% of the cohort by >8 points on staging sample.
Leah: posting postmortem draft to #customer-success-postmortems with timeline and outreach log. closing once AM replies are all acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
